notes.title: Better Controller Support
notes.notes:
[b]GIMME MORE[/b]

I've added a better controller assignment function in the splash screen. It should now automatically be able to detect and assign the correct bindings/mappings for XBox One Controllers, PS4 via BT or USB and Switch Pro Controllers via BT (all on Windows, tested on Win 10 and Win 11).  

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Josef | ROKOJORI

notes.title: Input Updates
notes.notes:
[b]New Input[/b]

The input system was changed. Previously the second keyboard input was shown for the input labels if the arrow keys were triggered. This is now changed and only the main keyboard input is shown.

More informations were added to the settings and the editing was updated.
It now explains that only the XBox Controller (XBox One, not Elite) is correctly supported. Other controllers will be added later.

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Josef | ROKOJORI

notes.title: Big Update 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome 2024![/b]

Oh boy! So much changed, that it's very hard to list everything! 

More than 50 tasks/features/bugs were processed since the last version.

[i]

- Lob pass for volley shots
- Graveyard Stadium
- Online Rankings starting with one challenge
- Complete Tutorial Guide
- New Inputs mechanism (Super Shot & Super Skills)
- Way faster loading times
- Match modifiers 
- Many game mechanic improvements
- Lots of bug fixes

[/i]


The whole thing took a while since tutorials and online rankings created some dependencies that were not that simple to resolve, so that it was hard to release a new version. Now everything is smooth again and new improvements can come in a much shorter time, hopefully in the next days!

I hope you'll enjoy this update, it improved a lot!


[b]Cheers,[/b]
Rokojori

notes.title: Early Access Release Update
notes.notes:
[b]Crazy days![/b]

I hope everybody could enjoy the Early Access release of Dash Cup Kickers! 
Thanks to everybody supporting the game! It means a lot! 

Gamescom was very fun, but also very exhausting! Thanks for everybody being there!
We had a lot of fun with our Indie Crew from Berlin & Brandenburg were really impressed by everthing.

Unfortunately, we had some problems setting up the Early Access release, and released it accidentally for a short time as "Full Released" on the store page. Ouch! I am very sorry for any confusion, it was a stupid technical mistake and I blame the chickens! Seriously though, I hope the start screen in-game could resolve the confusion a bit.

Good news on the other side, fresh new updates are awaitung us in the next weeks: 
1. Interactive tutorials and 2. Online highscore matches!

The tutorials will finally explain more in-depth how to do all the tricks, why the goal keepers have shields and all this interactively. Also on the career side, I will gradually open up the highscore matches, so that there will be always challenges and new stuff to play.

If you have any feedback, ideas or questions don't hestitate to ask. Either in the Steam Forums or on the [url=https://discord.gg/kay7YktXeb]Rokojori Discord Server[/url]


[b]Cheers[/b]
Josef | ROKOJORI

notes.title: Steam Deck Optimizations
notes.notes:
[b]Hi,[/b]

I am currently working on all fronts to squeeze out a very slick performance on Steam Deck. 

It started out with 20-25fps and now I can happily say it will run between 45-55fps (numbers are from the Steam Deck overlays). You can't imagine, what things can be a bottle neck for performance... 

There are still some things to do that I won't be able to fix, e.g. videos are not displayed at the moment because of compatibility issues, but in general, it is already very stable and a lot of fun to play. 

And I am so excited to be able to walk around on gamescom and let people test the game "on deck". Very, very cool! 

This will be the last update before the release and I hope you will like it on Tuesday. Let me know, what you think in a review!


[b]Cheers, [/b]
Rokojori
